text: This solution, Regional Drought Resilience Planning Program (Tasmania) — RDRP (Tasmania) addresses natural catastrophe in Australia between Resilience and Recovery Tasmania, Department of Premier and Cabinet (DPAC), Australian Government’s Future Drought Fund, Department of Agriculture, and Fisheries and Forestry (DAFF). The program was implemented in 2023 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
